result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full offline test suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passes. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

The change is in `PurchaseOrderStore.countPerSalesRep`, in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/PurchaseOrderStore.java`. Its count query now also applies the existing `NOT_CANCELLED` condition. Reps with no purchase orders are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I also updated two comments so they match the code. The `countPerSalesRep` javadoc now says cancelled orders are left out. The comment in `listForCountry` no longer says the per-rep count includes cancelled orders, since only the per-country count does now.
